title: Tags That Stick. Cartons You Can See Into.
tagline: Clear out excluded items in one step, write a custom tag once for the whole survey, put photos in your tag summaries, and see inside every carton.
summary: A customer-driven October release for HomeSurvey.ai standalone. Hide every excluded item from the report or delete them all from the dashboard in one step. Custom tags now persist across the whole survey (with a one-off option) and carry descriptions; every tag shows a one-line tooltip on hover. Tag summary tables can include item photos (off by default). Items packed in a carton can be listed on the report with an On report tick, without changing totals. Cartonable items show the AI's detected outline on the source photo and their ship/exclude quantities, volume and weight are editable. Ship and Exclude are editable in the item detail panel; the More menu is regrouped (Room notes, then Survey, Export as and PDF report) with a confirmation before Reset to AI capture; the walkthrough sort is renamed Capture Order; Survey Conversion shows 'No links sent' instead of 0%. Fixes: Save Draft no longer opens Review Complete, Reset to AI capture no longer duplicates rows, Room sort hidden inside a single room, duplicate voice notes, carton capacity above 100%.

title: The Photo Comes With It
tagline: A new Excel export puts every item’s photo in the row beside its description. Plus quoted amount and booked status on every survey, clearer statistics, and unused links that refund their credit.
summary: Export Excel (next to Export CSV in the More menu) builds an .xlsx with one row per item and the item's photo embedded beside its description; 14 columns (Room, Item, Photo, Category, Qty Ship, Qty Excl, Volume, Weight, Tags, In Carton, Pro-Gear, Reviewed, Flagged, Notes) with filters on Room, Category and Tags. CSV export is unchanged. HomeSurvey.ai standalone adds survey outcome fields: Quoted Amount, Move Date (optional at link creation), Booked and an automatic Booked Date, editable from Edit Info and at Review Complete. The Statistics row shows Customer Links Sent, Customer Surveys Completed, Survey Conversion, Generated by AI (hover for customer vs sales rep split), Reviewed by User and Survey Balance. Review Together badge and filter on the survey list. Unused survey links expire after 30 days and refund their credit. Fix: manually uploaded item photos save reliably.

title: The Photo Prints. The Tags Add Up.
tagline: Item photos on the report without tagging anything, tag summary tables with totals you can negotiate with, and a one-tap way to fix an item’s size.
summary: Item photos now print on the cube sheet PDF independent of tags: More > PDF report > Item photos turns on a photo for every item that has one, with a per-item Photo on report switch to turn individual photos off; photos print as thumbnails inside each item's own row. Tag summary tables: More > PDF report > Tag summary lists the tags on the survey with item counts; each ticked tag gets its own table (item, room, quantity, volume, weight, total row) after the rooms and before the questionnaire, with totals that reconcile with the survey. Change size, in each item's menu and the item detail panel, opens the catalog on the item's family and sets name, volume and weight in one tap.

title: Review Faster. Review Together.
tagline: The survey review dashboard, rebuilt for speed — and a live co-review session that puts you and your customer on the same screen, video call included.
summary: Dashboard V2 rebuilds the survey review around working through items: a detail panel with frame/video evidence, voice notes with transcripts, AI confidence, carton assignment, and tags — driven from the keyboard, with full mobile support and a one-click switch back to Classic. The header carries an AI Move Summary: shipped totals that update live with every edit, a move complexity gauge, and a customer-ready narrative. And Review Together puts the customer in the session: a shared link with built-in video calling, follow-me navigation, and live edit sync, read-only on their side, on desktop and mobile. Invites go to the email on file or via a copied session link; links expire after 24 hours.

title: Uploaded Before You Hit Submit
tagline: Videos compress and upload while the customer is still walking the house — plus a straight-to-Thank-You page, crating in the survey PDF, and a conversion card for your dashboard.
summary: Survey videos now compress and upload the moment they're recorded instead of waiting for Submit — clips over 60 MB are compressed (one typical walkthrough video dropped from ~175 MB to 11 MB, about 15× smaller), smaller clips upload as-is, interrupted uploads resume where they stopped, and if compression fails the original uploads so nothing is lost. Already-submitted survey links now open straight to the Thank You screen with clear customer details and cleaner totals that persist across refreshes. Crated items get a dedicated section in the survey PDF, and a new Survey Conversion card on the dashboard shows completed surveys against links sent (HomeSurvey.ai standalone).

title: Your Inventory, Your Call
tagline: Override weights, filter by tags, pick the right photo, and ship a Photos Appendix in the survey PDF — five features off one working mover's punch list.
summary: Five customer-driven inventory upgrades: a Sync Weight & Volume checkbox that lets reps override weight independent of volume (item header and AI summary show the override), tag-based filtering of the item list, selectable item photos (video frame, gallery, or camera — ending the random-photo bug on manual items), and a tag-driven Photos Appendix in the survey PDF (configure tags under Settings → Organization → PDF Image Tags; paid plans). Plus fixes: HVI and pro-gear count mismatches, item deletions from search now persist, and TVs, lamps, mirrors, and artwork categorize correctly.

title: Sweat the Small Stuff
tagline: A retry button exactly where you need it, ready-for-review emails that carry the numbers, and a survey that opens with your logo. June's quality batch.
summary: June's quality batch: failed room uploads now show a Retry button on the failed item itself (born from a crew member's basement capture with no signal), ready-for-review emails carry complexity score, crew size, total hours and the AI summary's key bullets in both HomeSurvey.ai and the CRM, and the survey welcome screen shows the mover's logo and sales rep name. Also: PDF download prompt after review, cleaner PDF footer number formatting, questionnaire FAQs, and a None move-type option.

title: Sent the Link? You Can Still Fix It.
tagline: Edit survey details after the link goes out, pin every survey to an address, and take a new account from signup to first survey in 90 seconds.
summary: Every survey now has an Edit Survey Info action: fix the customer name, email, address, and notes after the link is sent — the link keeps working, no void-and-resend. Move type deliberately locks at send. The Generate Survey Link form now takes an optional survey address, and a rebuilt first-run experience takes new accounts from signup to first survey in 90 seconds with guided steps, no empty states, and in-product help. Plus: long video uploads no longer fail when browser storage fills mid-upload.

title: Military Moves, By the Book
tagline: A dedicated Military move flag, and pro-gear weighed, itemized, and documented in its own PDF — before the move file needs it.
summary: Military moves get first-class treatment: a dedicated Military Move flag on the Generate Survey Link form, and a Pro-Gear PDF generated from the survey — every PBP&E item weighed and itemized, with running totals against the 2,000 lb member / 500 lb spouse allowances, ready for the move file. The same PDF also generates in Movegistics CRM, and pro-gear counts now agree across the AI summary, header stats, and dashboard filters.

title: The Margin Is in the Clutter
tagline: The same home, 24 more billable cartons. The AI survey is now sharper where the clutter — and the cartons — hide: the garage and the kitchen.
summary: The AI virtual moving survey now captures the high-clutter rooms more completely — nearly 100 new item types led by garage and kitchen, 15-23% more items per home, 20%+ sharper exclusions, and cross-video duplicate detection. On the same property: 320 to 394 items, 129 to 153 billable cartons (+24). Automatic on every new survey, no workflow changes.

title: Every Room, Photographed. See a Real Report.
tagline: Survey reports now include a room-level photo for every space. Browse a real 19-page AI output — unedited.
summary: Survey reports now include a timestamped room-level photo for every space captured during the walkthrough. Browse a real residential survey — 13 rooms, 126 items, 111 cartons, AI flags, and room notes. Redacted for privacy, unmodified otherwise.

title: Custom Questionnaire
tagline: Capture customer context before the AI even starts.
summary: Let movers configure general or move-type-specific pre-survey questions with branching logic. Customer answers flow into the AI pipeline, flag special items early, and surface in the review dashboard.

title: Voice Notes with Auto Exclude
tagline: "This bookshelf stays." The AI listens, understands, and excludes it automatically.
summary: During the video walkthrough, customers speak naturally about what stays and what goes. The AI transcribes, classifies, and auto-excludes items from the inventory — saving reps significant review time.

title: Interactive AI Move Summary
tagline: From raw inventory to crew plans and truck counts — recalculated live as you edit.
summary: The AI generates a complete move playbook — crew size scenarios, truck counts, packing hours, risk flags, and estimator tips. Edit the inventory and hit Recalculate to see updated estimates instantly.
